headline: Berlin Linke/Greens/SPD open coalition Vorgespräche (antisemitism & clan issues first); Proofpoint TA419 phished AI-policy experts; Anthropic: Barclays scales Claude; DE renewables ~61% of power use in Q1–Q3.

stories.title: Berlin: Linke, Greens, SPD open coalition Vorgespräche
facts: tagesschau/rbb (Thu ~11:47): Linke, Greens and SPD Spitzen began Dreier-Vorgespräche at Haus der Statistik (Alexanderplatz) — ~1h early to dodge photo ops; not yet Sondierungen.

Greens/SPD (via dpa/tagesschau): want binding agreements on antisemitism, protecting Jewish life, racism, organized crime and social cohesion before formal exploratory talks; Linke agreed to that sequence.
Linke won the Sep 20 Abgeordnetenhauswahl with 25.7%; Co-Fraktionschefin Elif Eralp could become Berlin’s first female Regierende Bürgermeisterin in a rot-grün-rote coalition.
Caution trigger: Neukölln election-night guests included an Arab-clan figure and a controversial pro-Palestinian activist; Linke MdB Ferat Kocak said Tue he would leave the Bundestag Innenausschuss.

If Vorgespräche clear: formal Sondierungen next week (teams already named); housing/rents — Linke/Greens push Vergesellschaftung of large landlords (~220k units), SPD’s Steffen Krach campaigned against Enteignungen.
stories.whyItMatters: The capital’s government formation is gated on trust questions around antisemitism and organized crime before policy bargaining even starts — and a Linke-led Berlin would be a national first.

stories.title: Proofpoint: China-aligned TA419 phished US AI-policy experts
facts: Proofpoint (Thu Oct 1): China-aligned actor TA419 ran credential-phishing against AI experts at US think tanks, universities and law firms — first public report on the group (seen since ≥ Apr 2025).
From 8 Jul 2026: impersonated Lynne Edwards Parker (ex White House OSTP) then Heidi Crebo-Rediker — fake AI Policy Advisory Committee and a purported SFRC AI export-controls report.
After a reply, shortened URLs led via actor-controlled domains to a fake OneDrive Adversary-in-the-Middle / Frameless BitB page targeting Microsoft 365 / Entra ID (session cookies, including MFA).
Feb 2026 precursor: spoofed a senior Anthropic employee (“Request for Feedback on Military Integration of Claude”) against a think-tank AI policy analyst — same AitM pattern.
Proofpoint: espionage aimed at US AI policy/regulatory landscape amid distillation/export-control friction; recommends passkeys and out-of-band verification of cold outreach.
stories.whyItMatters: Policy researchers — not just labs — are in the credential-theft crosshairs, with Anthropic-branded lures sitting next to fake Senate/White House personas.

image.alt: Open-graph image for Nextgov coverage of China-linked AI-policy phishing

stories.title: Anthropic: Barclays scales Claude across the bank
facts: Anthropic (Oct 1): Barclays is expanding its strategic collaboration to integrate Claude across global operations — software development, legacy modernization, ops efficiency.
Barclays expects Claude Code adoption to reach 50% of developers by end-2026 and a majority of software engineers in 2027.
Colleague Knowledge Assistant (live since 2025, Claude + RAG): >16,000 UK colleagues adopted; >1M searches supporting ~20M UK retail customers.
Global Markets: Claude helps classify/enrich/route ~120,000 emails/day; COOs Anne Marie Darling and Craig Bright framed it as agentic build/test/secure/operate with governance.
Anthropic CCO Paul Smith called it a significant UK milestone — security and oversight called out as the bank’s bar for AI.
stories.whyItMatters: A major universal bank is productizing Claude from knowledge assist into engineer tooling and markets ops — a concrete regulated-enterprise scale signal after morning’s Claude-for-Government GA.

image.alt: Anthropic announcement artwork for Barclays Claude partnership

stories.title: DE renewables: ~61% of electricity use in Q1–Q3 2026
facts: BDEW/ZSW (Thu Oct 1): renewables covered 60.7% of Germany’s gross electricity consumption in Jan–Sep 2026 — a record, +4pp vs year-ago, even as consumption rose 1.6%.
Renewable generation: 237.5 TWh (+8.7% YoY); drivers: onshore wind +9.1%, offshore wind +19.8%, PV +13.9%; hydro −14.3% (low rainfall), biomass −2.1%.
Build-out still high: PV gross additions 11.8 GW YTD (vs 11.0 GW prior-year period); onshore wind 3.5 GW (vs 3.1); offshore already 1.3 GW in 2026 vs 0.5 GW all of 2025.
Share of gross generation: 60.4%; BDEW’s Andreae urges EEG agreement + Verteilnetz acceleration; ZSW’s Staiß flags rising cooling demand in heatwaves.
stories.whyItMatters: Germany is clearing the 60% mark on consumption share midway through the year — the bottleneck narrative shifts further toward grids, connections and storage, not just turbines and panels.

stories.title: German manufacturing PMI final Sep: 53.9
facts: S&P Global final Germany Manufacturing PMI Sep: 53.9 (flash 53.8; Aug 54.3) — still expansion, slightly softer than August’s multi-year high.
Wire coverage: production up a 9th month; new orders up a 4th month with export demand from Asia, Europe and the US.
Cost pressures intensified after three months of easing — input-price inflation highest since June; output-price inflation a 3-month high; 12-month output expectations highest since February.
S&P Global’s Phil Smith: conditions holding up better than expected vs elevated energy prices and rising long-term rates.
stories.whyItMatters: Factories are still expanding into the energy-price shock — soft landing narrative for DE industry, with cost inflation the watch item.
